title: Accounting Rulebook - Domain Knowledge Index
description: Maps natural-language accounting requests to (1) the GAAP accounting classification, (2) the REAL route in this app where the transaction belongs, (3) the REAL element label to highlight, and (4) a plain-language explanation. Only real routes and real element labels that exist in this app are referenced. Never invent a route that is not listed here.

sales.type: Operating Revenue - Sale of Goods / Services
sales.explanation: Standard sales of goods or services are Operating Revenue. Record them with New Sales: pick the customer, add product/service line items, set dates and terms, then draft or post.

receipts.type: Cash Receipt - Money In from Customer
receipts.explanation: Money received from a customer is a Receipt (cash in). Record it with New Receipt: pick the customer, enter the amount, then draft or post.

payments.explanation: Money paid to a vendor is a Payment. Record it with New Payment: pick the vendor, enter the amount and line items, then draft or post.

disbursement.type: Cash Disbursement - Money Out from Cash Drawer
disbursement.explanation: A cash disbursement is a payment made out of the cash drawer. Record it with New Disbursement: pick the vendor, add line items, then draft or post.

collections.explanation: A collection records money received from a customer against the invoice. Record it with New Collection: pick the customer, enter the amount, then draft or post.

purchase.type: Purchases - Cost of Goods / Operating Expense
purchase.explanation: Purchases of goods/services for resale or expense are Operating Expenses. Record them with New Purchase: pick the vendor, add line items, then draft or post.

purchaseOrder.type: Purchase Order - Pre-commitment (not yet an expense)
purchaseOrder.explanation: A Purchase Order is a pre-commitment to buy and is not yet an expense until goods arrive. Record it with New Purchase Order.

adjustments.explanation: Adjusting and correcting journal entries belong in Adjustments. Note: this form is account-and-amount based (no product line items), but does have Remarks and Attachments.

advances.explanation: Cash advances given to employees are tracked in Advances as receivables until settled.

otherIncome.type: Other Income / Capital Gains (not operating revenue)
otherIncome.explanation: Trading gains, investment income, interest income and capital gains are classified as Other Income / Capital Gains, NOT standard operating product sales. Use a journal/adjustment entry against an Other Income or Capital Gains account in the Chart of Accounts.

customerTransactions.explanation: View every transaction belonging to a specific customer here.

vendorTransactions.explanation: View every transaction belonging to a specific vendor here.

vat.explanation: VAT input/output position is managed and reported in the VAT module and from the VAT % on each transaction line item.

withholdingTax.explanation: Withholding tax at source is computed from the WHT % on transaction line items and reported in the Withholding Tax module.

taxCompliance.explanation: The combined Tax Compliance module tracks both VAT and withholding tax compliance and filing.

trialBalance.explanation: The Trial Balance report shows the debit/credit balances of every account.

incomeStatement.explanation: The Income Statement report shows revenue, cost of sales and operating expenses to reach net income.

generalLedger.explanation: The General Ledger report lists all ledger account activity and transactions.

journalEntries.explanation: The Journal Entries report lists every debit/credit entry behind each transaction.

bankReconciliation.explanation: Reconcile the bank statement against the cashbook to surface missing or duplicate items.

auditTrail.explanation: The Audit Trail records every change and action taken by users in the system.

classificationKey: If it is revenue from selling products/services to customers -> /sales (Operating Revenue).
If it is money IN from a customer -> /receipts or /collections.
If it is money OUT to a vendor -> /payments or /disbursement.
If it is buying goods -> /purchase; if it is only a pre-commitment before goods arrive -> /purchase_order.
If it is Other Income / Capital Gains / trading / interest / investment returns -> Other Income or Capital Gains account via /adjustments (NOT /sales).
If it is a correction or adjusting journal entry -> /adjustments.
If it relates to VAT or withholding tax -> /vat or /witholding_tax respectively.
